page: Microsoft Azure NV6s_v2 is an NVSv2-family virtual machine configured with 6 dedicated vCPUs on an Intel x86_64 processor architecture. Operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 112.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 18.67 GB of RAM per vCPU. The hardware configuration includes a fractional GPU allocation of 0.5 GPU, alongside 754 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

The inclusion of a fractional GPU makes this server type a specialized option for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand a full dedicated GPU card. This resource partitioning provides qualitative cost efficiency by lowering the entry barrier for GPU-enabled computing. Combined with a substantial memory allocation of 112.0 GB and Premium Storage support, the instance is engineered for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, remote visualization, and entry-level machine learning inference tasks.
